name: What are the most common felony charges filed in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common felony charges filed in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common felony charges include assault with a deadly weapon, drug trafficking, burglary, robbery, and DUI causing injury. These dominate San Diego felony filings based on 2024 crime data.sandag+1​
